families.preconditions: Integer widths and signedness; checked overflow remains observable.
open_questions: Arithmetic timing does not qualify all widths, conversions or range-driven operations.
families.next_experiment: Compare signed/unsigned range variants and conversion boundaries with identical overflow checks.

families.preconditions: Strict floating operations; no fast-math; preserve signed zero, NaN and exact conversions.
open_questions: One recurrence timing does not qualify math calls, branch selection or exceptional operands.
families.next_experiment: Add NaN/signed-zero and math-helper equivalent probes; inspect native selection and call expansion.

families.preconditions: Preserve predecessor identity, short-circuit effects and error ordering.
open_questions: No dedicated timed branch/phi workload; block reduction is not a dynamic branch-cost proof.
families.next_experiment: Measure equivalent branch/select/phi kernels with shared conditions and observable fallible paths.

families.preconditions: Induction ranges must prove overflow, exit and index safety; retain negative and dynamic bounds.
open_questions: One timed loop does not qualify nested/strided/dynamic-bound or multi-exit loops.
families.next_experiment: Compare induction, LICM, rotation and cursor variants independently, then in interaction.

families.preconditions: Distinct roots can alias; calls, unknown effects and control boundaries invalidate local facts.
open_questions: LLVM still folds the readonly-view probe to a constant where Silex does not; cross-block effects are not generally covered.
families.next_experiment: Use ReadonlyViewMemory.sx to distinguish call specialization, range information and memory forwarding.

families.preconditions: Snapshots, addressable homes and alias-visible writes must survive scalar replacement.
open_questions: No timed aggregate/reference-return family; primitive aggregates do not cover classes, protocols or all owning fields.
families.next_experiment: Reduce aggregate calls/returns from Integration into independent width and alias variants; inspect copies and residence.

families.preconditions: Functional owning replacement preserves the original; mutable views alias; bounds errors remain observable.
open_questions: LLVM models scalar collection values, not reference-count cost, resource destruction or resource-bearing elements.
families.next_experiment: Separate value-semantic comparisons from lifetime/runtime cost; add observable destruction and allocation witnesses.

families.preconditions: Inlining must preserve errors/effects; profitability includes post-expansion lifetimes, spills and frames.
open_questions: Indirect calls and captured functions have no raw LLVM bridge; instruction count alone failed on reference closure.
families.next_experiment: Reduce Preparation/Integration calls to standalone positive/negative closure probes and inspect target expansion.

families.preconditions: Match failure kind and ordering; LLVM trap does not reproduce Silex diagnostic text.
open_questions: Fixed successful probes do not qualify emitted failing executions or all diagnostics against LLVM.
families.next_experiment: Add paired failure-path contracts distinct from successful-value timing; keep Silex interpreter/native diagnostics authoritative.

families.preconditions: Lanes must be independent and profitable after packing, extraction, calls and spills on each target.
open_questions: Width/pair contracts are structural; no timed vector family or physical X64 vector claim is established.
families.next_experiment: Compare widths 2/3/4, reductions and loop exits with target realization and packing costs visible.

families.preconditions: Text, resource effects and boundary operations retain order and lifetime.
open_questions: String operations, globals, dynamic/boundary calls and synchronization lack equivalent LLVM lowering.
families.next_experiment: Audit unsupported operations and add isolated semantic/runtime-cost witnesses without claiming LLVM equivalence prematurely.

families.preconditions: ABI barriers and addressable values retain storage; costs must count dynamic hot-region traffic.
open_questions: Structural X64 contracts and ARM64 timings do not close the physical X64 Arithmetic/Objects/Flocking residuals.
families.next_experiment: Run fixed reduced residence/barrier probes physically on both architectures; distinguish frame bytes from dynamic spill traffic.

families.preconditions: Compare identical source/closure or explicitly equivalent kernels; application architecture is a separate cause.
open_questions: Preparation/Integration still need autonomous same-workload probes; inherited external closure audit fails on GFX.ECS ancestry.
families.next_experiment: Extract stage kernels into compiler fixtures and qualify them before full external sentries; reconcile external proof ownership separately.
